claims.label: Charlie Kirk's 2018 message asserted he dreamed of being killed
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk wrote in a 2018 message to the host that he dreamed "all the time" about being killed and believed he might be "wiped out" at any time.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original 2018 text record or corroborating screenshots; compare wording to other contemporaneous Kirk statements.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk stated "I'm not really afraid of it" regarding his own death
claims.claim: In a 2018 follow-up text to the host, Charlie Kirk wrote that he was "not really afraid" of being killed.
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate the second message via original device records or screenshots.

claims.label: Baron Coleman asserted the situation constitutes a spiritual war with demonic forces
claims.claim: In an audio clip the host plays, Baron Coleman says he does not think a human is pulling the strings, and that the people co-opting Christian language do not answer to a human but 'to something far darker.'
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full unedited Coleman segment; verify no other named attribution in original show notes.

claims.label: Netanyahu asserted Israel did not kill Charlie Kirk on September 12, 2025
claims.claim: Two days after Charlie Kirk's assassination, Benjamin Netanyahu stated on Greta Van Susteren's show that Israel did not kill Charlie Kirk, calling the rumor "insane" and "stupid."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full unedited Van Susteren segment and verify whether the question was pre-arranged as host alleges.

claims.label: Greta Van Susteren raised the Israel-Kirk question in the September 12, 2025 interview
claims.claim: Greta Van Susteren asked Netanyahu to address internet rumors that Israel was behind Charlie Kirk's murder.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check segment against Van Susteren's own post-show statements.

claims.label: Host Says Israeli Foreign Ministry Contracted Show Faith by Works LLC via Havas Media on September 18, 2025
claims.claim: The host says that on September 18th the Israeli Foreign Ministry of Affairs, via Havas Media, contracted Show Faith by Works LLC, and says it is filed with FARA.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the FARA filing directly from DOJ FARA public registry; confirm registration date and contracting parties.

claims.label: Show Faith by Works LLC plans geofencing and church-targeted propaganda
claims.claim: The host says Show Faith by Works LLC is going to geofence phones on behalf of Israel and send pro-Israel and anti-Palestinian messages, plus an October 7th experience in church parking lots, and that it is filed with FARA.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare filing scope to actual deployed activities via FOIA or FARA supplemental filings.

claims.label: Host Says Clock Tower X LLC Registered with FARA on September 18, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Clock Tower X LLC filed a FARA registration on September 18, 2025, contracted via Havas Media on behalf of the Israeli Ministry of Foreign Affairs, for a strategic propaganda plan targeting the U.S. antisemitism narrative.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull original FARA filing from DOJ registry; confirm contracting parties and stated scope.

claims.label: Clock Tower X LLC is run by Brad Parscale
claims.claim: According to the FARA filing and the host, Clock Tower X LLC is run by Brad Parscale.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify corporate registration records for Clock Tower X LLC.

claims.label: Clock Tower X FARA filing lists Salem Radio Media Network as a target platform
claims.claim: The FARA filing for Clock Tower X LLC lists Salem Radio Media Network as the integration platform for narrative messaging across broadcast, podcast, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full filing exhibit; verify exact quoted language and listed platforms.

claims.label: Host Says Brad Parscale Became Chief Strategy Officer of Salem Media Network in January
claims.claim: The host says Brad Parscale became Chief Strategy Officer of Salem Media Network in January 2025, placing him simultaneously at Clock Tower X and Salem.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check Salem press releases and LinkedIn / corporate filings for Parscale's title and dates.

claims.label: Josh Hammer show displays low Newsweek view counts (~355–665)
claims.claim: The host shows Newsweek view counts for the Josh Hammer show of 399, 386 and 665, says 355 views looks like his average, and says it is a poor showing.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture live Newsweek view counts at multiple points in time; compare to alternative analytics.

claims.label: Salem Media announced landmark deal with Donald Trump Jr. and Lara Trump in April 2025
claims.claim: Per a Salem announcement article the host reads, in April 2025 Salem Media Group announced a landmark deal with Donald Trump Jr. and Lara Trump, including acquisition of a 30% stake in M-News and a long-term services agreement.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Salem's official press release and SEC / corporate disclosures.

claims.label: Salem Media acquired 30% stake in M-News app co-owned by Donald Trump Jr.
claims.claim: Per the Salem announcement article the host reads, pursuant to the April 2025 deal Salem acquired a 30% stake in M-News, a mobile news aggregation app co-owned by Donald Trump Jr.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify M-News corporate filings; confirm 30% acquisition price and structure.

claims.label: Host Says Pam Bondi Disbanded the DOJ Foreign Influence Task Force on February 5, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Pam Bondi, on her first day as Attorney General, disbanded the DOJ Foreign Influence Task Force; in a clip she plays, Ian Carroll reads the policy language and says the same.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain DOJ memorandum directly; confirm effective date and operative language.

claims.label: Disbanding limits DOJ from criminally charging PR work for foreign nations
claims.claim: Per the DOJ statement, recourse to criminal charges under FARA and 18 U.S. Code § 951 is limited to conduct similar to traditional espionage by foreign government actors.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare DOJ internal guidance before and after February 5, 2025; assess any subsequent FARA prosecutions.

claims.label: Harmeet Dhillon sworn in as Assistant AG for Civil Rights on April 7, 2025
claims.claim: Per a timeline the host shows, Harmeet Dhillon was sworn in on April 7, 2025 as Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights at the U.S. Department of Justice.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via DOJ announcement and Senate confirmation records.

claims.label: Dhillon Law Group drafted FARA paperwork for Clock Tower X and Show Faith by Works
claims.claim: According to the host's timeline, on August 27, 2025, Dhillon Law Group began drafting FARA registration paperwork for Havas Media on behalf of Clock Tower X LLC and Show Faith by Works LLC.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via FARA filing registrant of record and any disclosed outside counsel.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Kirk Sent September 9, 2025 Group Message Declaring Departure from Pro-Israel Cause
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk sent a group text on September 9, 2025 declaring he had been "given no choice but to abandon the pro-Israel cause" due to bullying and financial pressure.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original group text record; verify the participant list and exact wording.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk's memorial was geofenced on September 21, 2025
claims.claim: Per the host's timeline, on September 21st Charlie Kirk's memorial was geofenced.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check with FARA activity reports; obtain any device-level data on geofence delivery.

claims.label: Host Says Project 545 Represents a $545 Million Israeli Propaganda Initiative
claims.claim: The host says Project 545 refers to a $545 million State of Israel Ministry of Foreign Affairs propaganda initiative, the funding basis for the Clock Tower X / Show Faith by Works contracts; she says she believes this is the amount.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate primary source for Project 545 budget figure; cross-check against FARA contract disclosures.

claims.label: April 2 ruling dismissed 10 of 13 Blake Lively claims against Justin Baldoni
claims.claim: On April 2, a judge dismissed 10 of 13 claims Blake Lively had asserted against Justin Baldoni, leaving only breach of contract, retaliation, and aiding-and-abetting retaliation.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the actual April 2 court order; verify which claims survived and on what grounds.

claims.label: Blake Lively issued statement claiming the ruling supports her case
claims.claim: Per a statement from Blake Lively that the host reads, issued after the April 2 ruling, the ruling "allows the heart of my case to be presented to a jury next month."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Lively's official public statement archive.

claims.label: Host Says Community Notes Flagged Blake Lively's Statement as Misleading by Omission
claims.claim: The host says Community Notes appended to Blake Lively's statement said she is "misleading the public and lying by omission with this truncated cherry-picked snippets."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain screenshot of the Community Notes annotation; capture timestamp and full text.

claims.label: Host Says Deadpool & Wolverine Included "Nice Pool" Character Parodying Justin Baldoni
claims.claim: The host says Deadpool & Wolverine included a "Nice Pool" character and scene mocking Justin Baldoni, with Blake Lively playing "Mrs. Pool"; she plays a clip.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via official film credits and supplementary marketing material; confirm Baldoni-as-target framing.

claims.label: Host Says Deadpool Deleted Scenes Continued Baldoni Mockery
claims.claim: The host says deleted scenes from Deadpool & Wolverine contained additional content mocking Justin Baldoni, including a "podcast that monetizes the women's movement" line.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain deleted scene footage or trade press reporting on cut material.

claims.label: Host Says Justin Baldoni Watched It Ends With Us Premiere from Theater Basement
claims.claim: The host says Justin Baldoni was put in the basement of the It Ends With Us premiere and had to watch from there while the A-listers were upstairs, and that Blake Lively said she could not be in the same room as him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent eyewitness corroboration and any press coverage of the premiere seating arrangement.

claims.label: Mikey McCoy sent the host a message directing investigation toward Andrew Kolvet
claims.claim: The host says some people call Mikey McCoy the good guy for getting one message out to her to look into Andrew Kolvet.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original McCoy message screenshot; verify the exact language and date.

claims.label: Host Says Baron Coleman Is Number 33 on a Spotify Chart
claims.claim: The host says she is hearing that Baron Coleman is number 33 on a Spotify chart.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Spotify podcast chart for the date of the episode (2026-05-05) to confirm Coleman's rank.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm also hearing that Baron Coleman is number 33 on a Spotify chart.

claims.label: Host Says Israel Will Raise Its US Propaganda Spend to Almost a Billion Dollars This Year
claims.claim: The host says Israel is going to increase its spending on American propaganda to almost a billion dollars this year.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the primary reporting or budget document behind the figure (the episode chapter title says $730 million, which is not spoken in the transcript) and compare it to Israeli Ministry of Foreign Affairs and FARA disclosures.
claims.transcript_snippet: They are going to be upping their spend on American propaganda to almost a billion dollars this year.

claims.label: Host Says She Pulled Her Kids From School the Week Before Kirk's Death
claims.claim: The host says that in the week leading up to Charlie Kirk's death she had a terrifying, overwhelming feeling that led her to pull her kids out of school because she sensed danger coming to a school.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for a contemporaneous message, post or witness from the week of September 3 to 10, 2025 that records the host acting on the feeling; this is self-reported.
claims.transcript_snippet: the terrifying overwhelming feeling I had in the week leading up leading up to Charlie's death, which led me to pull my kids out of school cuz I sensed danger coming to a school.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Texted Kolvet and Flood the Night Before That They Were Going to Kill Him
claims.claim: The host says that the night before his death Charlie Kirk texted Andrew Kolvet and Dan Flood, the security people she says were meant to protect him, and wrote 'They are going to kill me.'
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the text thread from Kolvet's and Flood's phones (or the Harpole lawsuit discovery) and confirm date, time and exact wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: He texted Andrew Kolvet, he texted Dan Flood, and he said, "They are going to kill me."

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Wants Public to Believe Kirk Meant a Trans Person and Hopes the Harpole Lawsuit Will Show Who He Meant
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA wants the public to believe that Kirk's 'they are going to kill me' text referred to a trans person, and that she hopes the lawsuit with Brian Harpole will show whether he meant that.
claims.investigative_direction: Review TPUSA's public explanation of the text and the Harpole case docket for any production of the thread.
claims.transcript_snippet: they want us to believe that he meant a trans person. Okay. We'll see. Hopefully we'll be able to see in this lawsuit with Brian Harpole if he meant a trans person.

claims.label: Coleman Clip Says Kirk Recognized the Side He Supported Was Dark and Was Trying to Distance Himself When Killed
claims.claim: In the Baron Coleman audio clip, Coleman says he believes Charlie Kirk recognized that the side he had been supporting was dark and evil, was trying to distance himself from it, and was killed for it.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Kirk's own written statements about leaving the pro-Israel cause; Coleman did not know Kirk and states a belief, not evidence.
claims.transcript_snippet: He recognized the side he had been supporting was demonic and dark and evil and he was trying to distance himself from it and they killed him.

claims.label: Coleman Clip Says Kirk Was Killed for Turning His Back on the Prince of Darkness
claims.claim: In the Coleman audio clip, Coleman says the 'why' behind Kirk's killing is satanic: Kirk was turning his back on the prince of darkness and was killed by supporters of the prince of darkness.
claims.investigative_direction: None available beyond Coleman's stated belief; record as the clip's claim only.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie was turning his back on the prince of darkness. And he was removed for it. He was killed. By supporters of the prince of darkness, by the people doing his bidding.

claims.label: Host Says Tucker Carlson Used Words Like Spells About What Controls Trump
claims.claim: The host says Tucker Carlson talked about what is controlling Donald Trump using words like spells, and that critics mocked him for it.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Carlson segment and his exact wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: You see Tucker talking about that, and they're making fun of him where he's he's talking about what it is that is controlling uh Trump, and he's using words like spells

claims.label: Host Says the Charlie Kirk Show Is Hosted on Salem Media
claims.claim: The host says the Charlie Kirk Show is hosted by Salem Media and that Kirk was excited about that deal.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the distribution agreement between the Charlie Kirk Show and Salem Media Group from Salem's SEC filings and the show's own announcements.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, you should know that the Charlie Kirk show is hosted It's like a a Salem medium a Salem media, pardon me.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Adored Rush Limbaugh and Wanted to Host Three Hours of Radio Daily
claims.claim: The host says Kirk adored Rush Limbaugh and, he told her, listened to him on the way to school every day when he was young; she says he wanted to host three hours of radio every day and saw the Charlie Kirk Show as a means to fulfill that dream.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Kirk's public interviews for statements about Limbaugh's influence; the private conversation is host testimony.
claims.transcript_snippet: He adored Rush Limbaugh. He listened to Rush Limbaugh on the way to school every day when he was young. He told me that.

claims.label: Host Says a Tip Said Netanyahu's Office Asked Van Susteren's Team to Pose the Kirk Question
claims.claim: The host says she received a tip, which she did not run at the time, that Benjamin Netanyahu's office requested that Greta Van Susteren's team ask him whether Israel was behind Kirk's murder, so the question came from his side.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Van Susteren and her producers whether the question was pre-arranged and obtain the booking correspondence; the tip source is unnamed.
claims.transcript_snippet: the individual that Benjamin Netanyahu's office actually requested Greta's team to ask that question. So, that question came from them

claims.label: Host Says Show Faith by Works Would Send Anti-Palestinian Messaging and Run October 7th Experiences in Church Parking Lots
claims.claim: The host says the Show Faith by Works arrangement would give people pro-Israel and anti-Palestinian messages plus an October 7th experience in church parking lots.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the Show Faith by Works FARA exhibit to confirm the scope of messaging and the October 7th event component.
claims.transcript_snippet: they're going to give you pro-Israel and anti-Palestinian messages, plus this weird October 7th uh experience in church parking lots.

claims.label: Host Says LBJ Reversed Every JFK Policy Against Israel After Taking Office
claims.claim: The host says that after presidents who pressed Israel on FARA registration, LBJ assumed office and reversed course on every policy JFK had pursued against Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Historical question outside the case; compare with standard histories of the Kennedy and Johnson administrations and the 1963 FARA dispute over the American Zionist Council.
claims.transcript_snippet: LBJ assumed office and reversed course on every policy that JFK was pursuing against Israel.
